data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis): Reframe test_runner_extracts_json_from_markdown_fence. Markdown fence stripping is now handled inside llm-api-call.sh (the helper strips fences before returning). The runner receives already-stripped text. The existing test asserting the runner handles fenced output must be updated: either (a) drop it (coverage now in test-llm-api-call.sh) or (b) confirm the runner still parses plain JSON from the mock without error. Do not add a new fence-stripping path to the runner — that would duplicate llm-api-call.sh behavior.
